description: Transcription endpoint for African-language and English audio with optional sentence or word timestamps.

meta.deprecated_model_values: mansa_v1, legacy (the `model` parameter is deprecated; omit it)
meta.languages_note: Docs say many languages; en, yo, ha, ig, am are the ISO 639 codes named. Omitting language uses automatic language handling (response carries detected_language).

name: Spitch Speech to Text

pricing.notes: $0.00042 per second of input audio in the API docs pricing table; $0.0252 per minute on spitch.app/pricing; new developers get $1 free credit.

description: Speech synthesis endpoint with system and custom voices for English, Hausa, Igbo, Yoruba, Amharic and Nigerian Pidgin, streamed as chunked audio.

meta.custom_voices: POST /v1/voices from a reference recording + transcript + consent
meta.provenance: Signed provenance metadata embedded in wav, mp3, ogg_opus, webm_opus, flac
meta.raw_formats: wav, mp3, ogg_opus, webm_opus, flac, pcm_s16le, mulaw, alaw, m3u8 (HLS)
meta.streaming_note: Audio is streamed with chunked transfer encoding over HTTP
meta.yoruba_diacritization: Yoruba input is diacritized before synthesis

name: Spitch Text to Speech
